Title: [BACKEND] Fix 211 broad except handlers swallowing real errors
Description: Replace bare `except Exception as e: pass` with specific exception handling. Start with routes that have silent failures (photo upload, AI recognition, webhook processing). Broad handlers hide bugs and make debugging impossible.

Title: [BACKEND] Add mypy strict mode and fix 100+ type violations
Description: Enable strict mypy in pyproject.toml, fix 100+ type annotation violations. Focus on routes/ first (most user-facing), then services/, then integrations/. Type safety prevents runtime errors.

Title: [FRONTEND] Fix 11 files using raw fetch() instead of typed apiClient
Description: Replace raw fetch() calls in: contractors, service-requests, billing, workshop pages with typed apiClient calls. Ensures auth tokens are attached and errors are consistently handled.

Title: [FRONTEND] Add error.tsx and loading.tsx to all dashboard routes
Description: Create route-level error boundaries and Suspense loading states. Currently 0 route-level error handlers exist. Start with high-traffic routes: products, orders, customers, invoices.

Title: [DATABASE] Migrate 38 JSON columns to JSONB
Description: Replace `Column(JSON)` with `Column(JSONB)` for all 38 JSON columns. JSONB indexes are supported; JSON is not. Affects: workshop models (7), workflow models (6), Cin7 models (25). Requires migration.

Title: [DATABASE] Add ondelete rules to 50 FKs without cascade behavior
Description: 50 foreign key columns have no `ondelete` specified. When parent records are deleted, child records may be orphaned. Audit each FK and add appropriate CASCADE/SET NULL/RESTRICT based on business logic.

Title: [INTEGRATION] Add retry with backoff to Xero API client
Description: Xero API calls have no retry logic. Add exponential backoff (3 retries, 2^n seconds) for 429 and 5xx responses. Model after Cin7 client which has this pattern already.

Title: [INTEGRATION] Add retry with backoff to SendGrid client
Description: SendGrid email sending has no retry logic. Failed emails silently disappear. Add 3-retry backoff pattern matching Cin7 client pattern.

Title: [INTEGRATION] Implement circuit breaker pattern for external API calls
Description: No circuit breaker exists for any integration. When Cin7/Xero/Shopify is down, cascading failures can block the whole system. Implement circuit breaker in httpx client wrapper.

Title: [INTEGRATION] Add 429 rate-limit handling across all integrations
Description: No integration handles 429 Too Many Requests. When rate-limited, current code throws immediately. Add Retry-After header parsing and respect backoff across all 12 integrations.

Title: [DEVOPS] Remove hardcoded localhost from 3 production config files
Description: Found localhost:8000 hardcoded in next.config.ts CSP, mobile.ts client, and 1 other file. Replace with environment variables. Production uses different URL.

Title: [DEVOPS] Add structured logging correlation IDs for request tracing
Description: All logs use structlog but lack request correlation IDs. Debugging multi-step flows (photo upload → recognition → order) requires request ID threading. Add X-Request-ID middleware.

Title: [DEVOPS] Add Redis health check to CI/CD pipeline
Description: Redis is in docker-compose but not verified in CI/CD. If Redis is down, cached routes silently degrade. Add explicit health check in ci.yml.

Title: [DEVOPS] Document all 27+ undocumented environment variables
Description: 27 env vars in production have no documentation in .env.example. New deployments fail mysteriously. Document all vars with type, description, and example values.

Title: [SECURITY] Upgrade 3 dependencies with known CVEs
Description: Run `pip audit` — found packages with known CVEs: fix before next production deploy. Exact list in 06-security-audit.md.

Title: [SECURITY] Add CSRF protection to state-changing API endpoints
Description: State-changing endpoints (POST/PUT/DELETE) lack CSRF tokens. FastAPI CORS is configured but client-side CSRF protection is missing. Add double-submit cookie pattern.

Title: [SECURITY] Replace demo_auth.py default JWT secret in non-dev environments
Description: JWT_SECRET defaults to empty string with only a warning in development. If a dev ever deploys with the default, tokens are forgeable. Fail hard if JWT_SECRET not set in non-local environments.

Title: [SECURITY] Add rate limiting to auth endpoints (login
Description: token refresh)
Priority: Login and token refresh endpoints have no rate limiting. Vulnerable to credential stuffing. Add slowapi or similar: 5 req/min per IP on /api/auth/*.

Title: [SECURITY] Validate webhook payloads for Xero and AP2 integrations
Description: Cin7 webhooks use HMAC-SHA256 ✅. Xero and AP2 webhook handlers accept any payload without signature verification. Add HMAC validation matching Cin7 pattern.

Title: [PERFORMANCE] Fix N+1 query pattern in /api/orders endpoint
Description: Orders list endpoint fetches orders then N individual customer queries. Replace with SQLAlchemy `selectinload(Order.customer)` eager loading. Affects 3 endpoints: orders, quotes, invoices.

Title: [PERFORMANCE] Add pagination to 8 list endpoints currently returning all records
Description: 8 endpoints return all records with no pagination: /api/customers, /api/products, /api/inventory, /api/activities, /api/workshop/equipment, /api/alerts, /api/notifications, /api/agents. Add page/page_size params with max 100.

Title: [PERFORMANCE] Add composite index on orders(customer_id
Description: status
Labels: Most dashboard queries filter orders by customer + status. Missing composite index causes full table scans. Add: ix_orders_customer_status_created to Alembic migration.

Title: [PERFORMANCE] Enable Redis caching for product catalog and price lists
Description: Product catalog is fetched on every page load with no caching. Redis is in docker-compose but unused on catalog endpoints. Cache catalog with 5-minute TTL, invalidate on product update.

Title: [PERFORMANCE] Add bundle analysis to CI to catch size regressions
Description: Next.js bundle is not measured in CI. No threshold prevents large bundle additions. Add @next/bundle-analyzer to ci.yml with size threshold alert at 500KB per route.

Title: [TESTING] Add backend pytest tests for new inventory endpoints (UNI-172 SUB-8)
Description: New inventory endpoints (barcode, stock take, reorder, variants) have no backend tests. Add pytest tests covering happy path + validation errors for each endpoint.

Title: [TESTING] Add E2E Playwright specs for warehouse and workshop flows
Description: Warehouse page and workshop booking flow have no E2E coverage. Add playwright specs for: create booking, update equipment, view schedule.

Title: [TESTING] Add unit tests for 10 highest-priority frontend pages
Description: Frontend has 5 test files for 76 pages (6.5% coverage). Priority: billing, workshop, warehouse, contractors, approvals, alerts, CRM health, onboarding, personas, mobile order.

Title: [TESTING] Add contract tests for Cin7 API integration
Description: No contract tests exist for Cin7 integration. When Cin7 changes their API, we find out in production. Add Pact consumer contract tests for top 10 Cin7 endpoints.

Title: [TESTING] Fix 17 pre-existing test failures (walk-in
Description: service
Labels: 17 tests failing due to missing portal component imports (removed in SaaS cleanup). Either restore test stubs or delete orphaned test files. Blocking accurate coverage metrics.

Title: [DATABASE] Standardise SQLAlchemy model style (1043 Column() → Mapped[])
Description: 42 model files use mixed Column() legacy style and Mapped[] new style (SQLAlchemy 2.0). Standardise to Mapped[] for type safety and consistency. Prioritise new files first.

Title: [FRONTEND] Enable TypeScript strict mode in tsconfig.json (UNI-1255)
Description: TypeScript strict mode is disabled. Enabling it (noImplicitAny, strictNullChecks) would catch 50-100 additional type errors. Requires fixing errors incrementally.

Title: [SECURITY] CRITICAL — X-User-Id header accepted as auth without JWT validation
Description: Security audit found auth.py lines 96–100 accept X-User-Id header as identity without any JWT verification. Any HTTP client that knows a user's UUID can send X-User-Id: <uuid> and bypass all authentication checks. This is a complete authentication bypass. Fix immediately: remove the X-User-Id header auth path entirely or enforce JWT presence when this header is used.

Title: [DEVOPS] Remove continue-on-error from backend test step in ci.yml
Description: ci.yml has continue-on-error: true on both the alembic migration step AND the pytest step. Broken backend code produces a green CI badge and merges to main undetected. Remove continue-on-error from both steps. Also raise coverage threshold from 15% to at least 50%.

Title: [PERFORMANCE] Re-enable 9 dashboard cache decorators (Pydantic serialisation fix)
Description: All 9 Redis cache decorators in demo_dashboard.py are commented out due to a Pydantic v2 serialisation issue. The highest-traffic page hits raw DB aggregations on every load. Fix the serialisation issue (use model_dump() instead of dict()) and re-enable caching.

Title: [TESTING] Track 7 untracked test files in git (they never run in CI)
Description: 7 test files are untracked (git status shows them as ??): test_billing.py, test_gap_batch_2b.py, test_approvals_batch_2c.py, test_batch_2c_structure.py, test_workflows_batch_2c.py, test_gap_batch_2b_smoke.py. Run git add on these files so they execute in CI.

Title: [SECURITY] Swagger UI /docs and /openapi.json publicly accessible in production
Description: FastAPI auto-generates API documentation at /docs and /openapi.json with no authentication gate. This exposes all endpoint details, request schemas, and auth patterns to anyone. Disable in production: app = FastAPI(docs_url=None if not DEBUG else '/docs').

Title: [SECURITY] Prometheus /metrics endpoint is unauthenticated
Description: GET /metrics exposes revenue figures, order counts, and AI performance metrics publicly with no auth. Add IP allowlist or bearer token to prometheus.yml and the metrics endpoint.

Title: [DEVOPS] Add missing node-exporter service to docker-compose.yml
Description: prometheus.yml declares a node-exporter scrape target but the service is missing from docker-compose.yml. All CPU/memory alert rules never fire. Add the prom/node-exporter image to docker-compose.yml.
